groups.title: Zoldyck Family
groups.def: Blood and marriage members of the Zoldyck assassin family.

groups.title: Zoldyck Butlers
groups.def: Servants of the Zoldyck estate shown and named on screen in the anime.

groups.title: Phantom Troupe
groups.def: Characters shown holding a numbered spider tattoo as members of Chrollo's Phantom Troupe at some point in the anime.

groups.title: Enhancers
groups.def: Characters whose Nen type is Enhancer.

groups.title: Transmuters
groups.def: Characters whose Nen type is Transmuter.

groups.title: Conjurers
groups.def: Characters whose Nen type is Conjurer.

groups.title: Emitters
groups.def: Characters whose Nen type is Emitter.

groups.title: Manipulators
groups.def: Characters whose Nen type is Manipulator.

groups.title: Specialists
groups.def: Characters whose Nen type is Specialist (Kurapika's base type is Conjurer, but his Scarlet Eyes ability is Specialist-classified).

groups.title: The Zodiacs
groups.def: The twelve Hunter Association committee members named after zodiac animals who elected the 13th Chairman.

groups.title: Chimera Ant Royal Guard
groups.def: Meruem, the Chimera Ant King, and the three Squadron Leaders who form his personal Royal Guard.

groups.title: Chimera Ants
groups.def: Characters born as Chimera Ants, shown in the anime.

groups.title: Greed Island
groups.def: Characters central to the Greed Island arc, as players, Game Masters, or the game's designer.

groups.title: Hunter Exam Applicants
groups.def: Characters shown taking the 193rd Hunter Exam alongside Gon, whether or not they passed.

groups.title: Heavens Arena
groups.def: Characters shown fighting or training at Heavens Arena during the anime.
